mapper.select: SELECT u.id,u.nickname,u.user_status,u.register_status,r.role_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.user_id=u.id AND r.enabled=1 WHERE u.id=#{id}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND SUM(u.nickname='自动操作' AND u.user_status='disabled' AND u.register_status='new' AND u.phone_verified=0 AND u.avatar_url IS NULL AND u.phone IS NULL AND u.phone_source IS NULL AND u.phone_verified_at IS NULL)=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id=#{id}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_account WHERE user_id=#{id}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_login_identity WHERE user_id=#{userId}
